name: Currency Converter
tagline: Live exchange rates from the European Central Bank
description: Convert any amount between 30+ world currencies using live exchange rates from the European Central Bank (ECB). Updated daily. Uses the free Frankfurter API — no API key required.

expert_defs.name: currency_converter_convert
expert_defs.description: Converts currency amounts using live ECB rates via frankfurter.app. Params: amount (number), from_currency (3-letter ISO code), to_currency (3-letter ISO code). Returns JSON with output_type json containing converted amount and rate.

conceptTexts: Plugin: Currency Converter (id: currency-converter). Expert currency_converter_convert converts currency using live ECB rates via frankfurter.app. Params: amount (number), from_currency (ISO code), to_currency (ISO code). Returns {output_type: 'json', data: {amount, from, to, converted, rate, date}}.
